semantics.operation: Combinational addition when do_sub=0 and subtraction when do_sub=1; flag equals whether out is zero.
semantics.timing: Original always @(*) has no clock or latency; observe after combinational settling.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior in original.
semantics.initialization: No specified initial state; outputs derive from supplied inputs.

numeric.result: Low eight bits of sum or difference, modulo 256
numeric.zero_flag: 1 iff the eight-bit result equals 0; otherwise 0

verification.oracle: Original adder-subtractor purpose and original a+b/a-b expressions; integer arithmetic modulo 256, zero comparison.
verification.coverage: Exhaustive binary inputs for both operations plus directed wraparound and transitions from zero to nonzero.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs then wait one time unit for combinational settling.
verification.failure: Fatal mismatch and bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original does not specify functional requirements for X/Z inputs or do_sub outside 0/1.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Verify all binary inputs; do not impose additional X/Z behavior.
